spans.s:
The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'what stays there' after the words 1. वेशन्त and 2. हिमवत् , in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: अण्

The affix थल् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) with the force of मतुप् after the word भग having the words 1. वेशस् or 2. यशस् in the beginning.

Terms: थल्

The ष् is substituted for the स् of स्वन् after वि and अव when the sense is 'to smack while eating'.

Terms: षत्व change
